handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:108-175 composes prenex conversion (thm:prenex-normal-form, handbook/restoration/inherited-05132-05567.tex:262-282, whose written proof chains lem:fol-nnf, lem:rectified-variant, lem:prenex-extraction), Skolemization (definition handbook/restoration/inherited-05132-05567.tex:284-301, theorem handbook/restoration/inherited-05132-05567.tex:316-430) and CNF/clause conversion Cl (method handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:81-101, pointwise lemma handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:103-114, proof handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:71-104). Freshness and signature changes are explicit: fresh binders from a fixed infinite variable enumeration outside a finite forbidden set (handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:116-118, handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:144-147); NNF/rectify/prenex add no nonlogical symbol (handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:116-117, handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:141-151); one fresh function symbol per existential prefix position, arity zero for an initial existential, finitely many, in expansion L* (handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:122-127, handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:117-118, handbook/restoration/inherited-05132-05567.tex:290-301); Cl stays in L* and adds no variable or symbol (handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:139-140, handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:112); the clause-closure step is justified (handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:142-163) rather than by erasing the prefix.

Directions stated: same-signature formula equivalence for NNF, rectification, prenex and CNF matrix; expansion-reduct equisatisfiability only for the Skolem step (handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:119-124; table row 4 handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:152-157 'not same-signature formula equivalence'; figure caption handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:203-207). The expansion direction uses AC and the reduct direction is choice-free (handbook/restoration/inherited-05132-05567.tex:316-330, handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:130-133, handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:165-174). Explicit disclaimers that Skolemization does not preserve equivalence (handbook/restoration/inherited-05132-05567.tex:432-435) and that no same-signature equivalence across Skolemization is claimed (handbook/annex/p02/clausal-form-composition.tex:173-174). The clause-set relation is stated as sameness of models through universal closures, not formula-string equivalence (handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:166-169, handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:205-206, handbook/parts/p02/first-order-normal-forms-supplement.tex:215-216).
